import json
# Capture current node summary before action
def snap(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']>5:
            out.append((n['id'],n['color'],n['pixels'],n['boundary'][:4]))
    return out
before = snap(current_frame)
res = action(['SPACE'])
after = snap(current_frame)
print("res:", {k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','done','level_completed','game_over','reward') if k in res})
print("BEFORE:")
for x in before: print(" ",x)
print("AFTER:")
for x in after: print(" ",x)
# diff by color+pixels
bset = {(x[1],x[2]) for x in before}
aset = {(x[1],x[2]) for x in after}
print("gone:", bset-aset)
print("new:", aset-bset)
